items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled theorem thm:equiv-iso-adj at source lines 215-217: every quasi-inverse of a map f can be promoted to a half adjoint equivalence. The author's proof (source lines 218-242) cannot follow the most obvious route, because the second homotopy of the given quasi-inverse has to be replaced by the corrected family epsilon-prime(b) built from the inverse of epsilon at f(g(b)) and the action of f on eta at g(b) (source lines 222-227), and only then can the coherence path tau(a) be stated (source lines 228-231). Producing that path needs two separate computations: the naturality of eta rewrites eta at g(f(a)) as the action of g on the action of f on eta at a (source lines 232-234), and the naturality of epsilon moves the action of f on that composite past epsilon(f(a)) (source lines 235-240), after which the common right factor is cancelled (source line 241). The statement indicates neither that the second homotopy must be modified nor which naturality squares close the coherence.
